literal: Relieving the ruinous hunger of the destitute, that is the place where a man who has obtained wealth stores it.
translation: Relieving the ruinous hunger of the destitute is the very place where a man who has acquired wealth should store it.
modern: வறியவர்களின் அழிக்கும் பசியைத் தீர்ப்பதுதான், செல்வம் பெற்ற ஒருவன் தன் பொருளைச் சேமித்து வைக்கும் இடமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the true and secure way to store one's wealth. It states that satisfying the intense, ruinous hunger of the destitute is the ultimate treasury for a wealthy person. Rather than hoarding riches in physical vaults where they can be lost, spending them to feed the needy acts as an imperishable storehouse. The word 'அழிபசி' highlights the devastating nature of hunger, while 'வைப்புழி' metaphorically frames charity as the safest place of deposit.
